title: Publish scheduler claim-composition surface on @moe/scheduler root
description:
Objective: make the scheduler authority and budget claim-composition surface reachable from outside @moe/scheduler, so apps/daemon can compose it. Blocker-fix task 1 of 2, created by architect-8a4a1764 on 2026-08-08 under human approval in the REPL, after task-ba3a45f9 (Daemon work services, SPIDR child 3) was found unbuildable from its owned paths.

WHY THIS EXISTS - evidence, probed not assumed, from apps/daemon with both controls:
  node --experimental-strip-types -e "import('@moe/scheduler/authority/lease-resource.js')"
    -> DEEP FAIL ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED
  node --experimental-strip-types -e "import('@moe/scheduler')"
    -> ROOT OK exports=17
The 17 root exports are ALL graph-kernel (validateGraphSnapshot, analyzeGraphStructure, analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals, partitionFrontier, previewGraphSnapshot, resolveGraphPolicy, createTraversalCounter, GraphAnalysisError, and 9 graph policy constants). packages/scheduler/package.json pins "exports": {".": "./src/index.ts"}, which is an EXCLUSIVE map: no subpath import resolves, at runtime or under moduleResolution NodeNext. So reserveAll / reserveProviderSlot / fenceAuthority / the budget reservation records are unreachable from every package except scheduler itself. Verified zero external consumers today: the only mention of fenceAuthority outside packages/scheduler is a COMMENT in packages/runner/src/supervisor/lease-mirror.ts:33.

Deliverable: extend packages/scheduler/src/index.ts with the claim-composition surface, following the file's existing export style (value exports grouped by module, then a `export type { ... }` block, all specifiers written with the .js extension per NodeNext). Minimum symbol set, driven by what task-ba3a45f9's four-leg atomic claim needs:
  - from ./authority/lease-resource.js : reserveAll, reserveProviderSlot, adapterConfirm, adapterFail, grantSuccessorCapacity + the AuthorityOutcome / ReserveAllResult / ProviderSlotReservation / AcquisitionSet types
  - from ./authority/lease-fencing.js  : fenceAuthority, parseLeaseRecord, parseProof, parseClock + the Fenced type
  - from ./authority/resource-model.js : SLOT_STATES, SlotState and the acquisition row types the above signatures name
  - from ./budget/budget-reservation.js: reserveForAdmission, activateReservation, cancelReservation, deriveReservationId, ADMISSION_PURPOSES, PROTECTED_ADMISSION_PURPOSES, ADMISSION_PURPOSE_RESERVE_CONTRACT, RESERVATION_STATES, BUDGET_RESERVATION_ISSUE_CODES + BudgetAvailableView, AdmissionRequest, AdmissionGate, ReservationRecord, ReservationState, BudgetReservationResult, BudgetReservationIssueCode and the command types
Add whatever transitive types those signatures reference (from ./authority/authority-kernel.js and ./budget/budget-contract.js) so a consumer can name every parameter and every branch of every return type without a deep import. Update the index.ts header docblock: its current "pure structural graph-analysis kernel" summary stops being the whole truth once authority and budget ship on the same entry point.

NO new .js bridges are needed here - verified: every module under packages/scheduler/src/authority/ and packages/scheduler/src/budget/ already has its tracked one-line sibling bridge (mem:gotcha-scheduler-js-shims). This task must not create, delete, or edit any bridge.

NOT in scope: changing any authority or budget BEHAVIOUR; adding a slot-count ceiling (design 427's four-slot project-wide limit is deliberately absent from reserveProviderSlot, which validates one slot and does no counting - the counting belongs to the daemon caller and is task-ba3a45f9's work); touching packages/runner; touching apps/daemon; any package.json or lockfile edit.

Hard dependencies: none. The authority children (lease presence core task-967769ea) and all five conserved-budget children are DONE. This task is independent of supervisor SPIDR children 1 and 2 and can start immediately.

Owned paths: packages/scheduler/src/index.ts, packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts (new).
Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck
definitionOfDone: Every symbol named in the description is exported from packages/scheduler/src/index.ts, and a consumer can name every parameter type and every union branch of every exported function's return type without any deep subpath import.

A new packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts imports the package ROOT specifier @moe/scheduler (never a relative or deep path) and asserts, per symbol, that the export is present and of the expected typeof - so a dropped export fails the suite by name rather than by a vague count.

The same test pins the surface against silent loss: it asserts set equality between Object.keys of the namespace and a hand-written expected export list, so both a removed export AND an unreviewed addition go red. The list is hand-transcribed, never derived from the namespace under test (mem:gotcha-self-derived-universe-cannot-check-itself).

A plain-Node probe run from the repo root proves the new surface actually loads outside vitest, with BOTH controls recorded in the completion evidence: import('@moe/scheduler') resolves and its namespace contains reserveProviderSlot and fenceAuthority (positive), and a deep subpath import still raises ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED (negative control proving the exports map stayed exclusive). A vitest-only gate is not evidence the module loads (mem:gotcha-vitest-hides-missing-js-bridge).

Zero behaviour change: no non-test file under packages/scheduler/src/authority/ or packages/scheduler/src/budget/ is modified, no .js bridge is added or edited, and the pre-existing scheduler suite passes with the same test count as before this task.

pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck exits 0; committed paths are exactly packages/scheduler/src/index.ts and packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts.
taskRails: Re-export only. This task changes what is REACHABLE, never what any function DOES. If a symbol seems to need a signature change to be exportable, stop and report_blocked rather than editing authority or budget logic.
Do not add, remove, or edit any .js bridge - packages/scheduler/src/authority/** and budget/** are already fully bridged, and an unnecessary bridge edit is an unowned change to shared runtime state.
Assert the reason code, not just the outcome: the exclusive-exports negative control must assert the literal ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED, never merely that the deep import failed.

Keep the production file focused: target <=250 lines, split before 400. packages/scheduler/src/index.ts is 81 lines today - if the added surface would push it past 250, extract the authority/budget re-exports into a sibling module that index.ts re-exports, rather than letting the entry point sprawl.

Commit by explicit pathspec only: git commit -- packages/scheduler/src/index.ts packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts. Never a bare git commit; the index is shared across concurrent tasks (epic rail 3).

implementationPlan.description: Establish the TDD baseline and create the RED root-surface contract. Before editing, run the existing scheduler suite once and record its file/test counts in the step evidence so the final total can distinguish the new surface cases from the unchanged pre-existing suite. Add index-surface.test.ts with `import * as scheduler from "@moe/scheduler"` and type-only imports from that same root specifier only. Hand-transcribe an alphabetized 36-value expected namespace: the verified 17 graph values plus ADMISSION_PURPOSES, ADMISSION_PURPOSE_RESERVE_CONTRACT, BUDGET_RESERVATION_ISSUE_CODES, PROTECTED_ADMISSION_PURPOSES, RESERVATION_STATES, SLOT_STATES, activateReservation, adapterConfirm, adapterFail, cancelReservation, deriveReservationId, fenceAuthority, grantSuccessorCapacity, parseClock, parseLeaseRecord, parseProof, reserveAll, reserveForAdmission, and reserveProviderSlot. Assert exact set equality and one named expected typeof assertion per value (functions/classes versus arrays/objects/numbers), never a count-only check. Add compile-time/expectTypeOf coverage proving every exported function parameter and each success/refusal union arm is nameable using the root-exported types: AuthorityOutcome, AuthorityErrorCode, AuthorityIssue, AuthorityProof, AuthorityRejection, ClockObservation, Fenced, LeaseKind, LeaseRecord, LeaseState, RejectionSecurityRecord; AcquisitionFailure, AcquisitionSet, AcquisitionState, DeclaredResource, ProviderSlotReservation, ReserveAllRequest, ReserveAllResult, ResourceRow, ResourceWaitRequest, SlotState; AdmissionAmount, AdmissionGate, AdmissionHumanApproval, AdmissionPolicyAllowance, AdmissionPurpose, AdmissionRequest, BudgetAvailableView, BudgetReservationIssue, BudgetReservationIssueCode, BudgetReservationResult, ReservationActivateCommand, ReservationCancelCommand, ReservationLine, ReservationRecord, ReservationState; and BudgetAccountState, BudgetMeterBuckets, BudgetPolicyOutcome, BudgetReservePurpose. Assert the matrix/list has the exact positive cardinality, then run only this test and confirm RED specifically names missing requested root exports.

Publish the minimum explicit root surface in index.ts, without modifying behavior. Rewrite the header docblock to describe three zero-minting composition areas—structural graph analysis/preview, caller-supplied authority fencing/resource reservation, and caller-supplied conserved-budget admission reservation—and retain the warning that the scheduler does not invent dependency, policy, lease, or execution authority. Add grouped value exports from `./authority/lease-resource.js` (reserveAll, adapterConfirm, adapterFail, reserveProviderSlot, grantSuccessorCapacity), `./authority/lease-fencing.js` (fenceAuthority, parseLeaseRecord, parseProof, parseClock), `./authority/resource-model.js` (SLOT_STATES), and `./budget/budget-reservation.js` (reserveForAdmission, activateReservation, cancelReservation, deriveReservationId, ADMISSION_PURPOSES, PROTECTED_ADMISSION_PURPOSES, ADMISSION_PURPOSE_RESERVE_CONTRACT, RESERVATION_STATES, BUDGET_RESERVATION_ISSUE_CODES). Add explicit type-only blocks from authority-kernel, lease-fencing, resource-model, budget-reservation, and budget-contract for every type named in step 1. Use only `.js` specifiers, no export-star, no aliases, no signature edits, no package.json change, and no bridge or authority/budget file edit. Keep index.ts at or below 250 physical lines and make the new root-surface test green.

Perform the single adversarial review over the two owned paths. Compare every value/type name against its defining export and each public function signature; verify the type closure covers both branches rather than only happy-path parameters, no helper/private value leaked, the 17 graph keys remain unchanged, and the header does not imply new authority. Check null/hostile-input behavior was not touched because this is reachability-only. Mutation-drill the production surface by temporarily removing `fenceAuthority` (and separately, if needed, adding an unapproved exported value such as ACQUISITION_STATES): the named typeof/set-equality surface test must go red, proving both loss and addition axes are load-bearing. Restore the exact original owned bytes in a finally path, confirm no bridge/package/authority/budget diff exists, no scratch file remains, and index.ts is <=250 physical lines.

Run the final verification from the repository root. First record both plain-Node controls via `pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec node --experimental-strip-types`: the positive `import('@moe/scheduler')` must report `typeof reserveProviderSlot === 'function'` and `typeof fenceAuthority === 'function'`; the negative `import('@moe/scheduler/authority/lease-resource.js')` must exit successfully only when the caught `error.code` is exactly `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`. Then run the required foreground gate exactly: `pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler test && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`. Record exit 0 and show that the pre-existing scheduler tests retain their baseline count while the final total adds only the new surface cases. Inspect `git diff -- packages/scheduler/src/index.ts packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts` and `git status --porcelain`; unstage foreign entries without altering them, stage only these two owned paths, commit only with `git commit -- packages/scheduler/src/index.ts packages/scheduler/src/index-surface.test.ts`, and verify `git show --stat` contains exactly those paths before calling moe.complete_task.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Keep packages/scheduler/package.json's exclusive root-only exports map and publish an explicit curated root surface. Deep/subpath exports are rejected because they would widen the runtime boundary, and export-star forwarding is rejected because it would silently publish helpers and make the expected namespace unstable. A sibling export module is unnecessary: the current index is 79 physical lines and the explicit value/type blocks fit below 250. No authority/budget behavior file or existing .js bridge is touched.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: A live plain-Node package-self-reference probe invoked from the repository root via `pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec node --experimental-strip-types` reports exactly 17 current runtime keys: ABSOLUTE_MAX_GRAPH_HARD_EDGES, ABSOLUTE_MAX_GRAPH_NODES, ABSOLUTE_MAX_GRAPH_TOTAL_EDGES, DEFAULT_GRAPH_POLICY, DEFAULT_MAX_HARD_EDGES, DEFAULT_MAX_NODES, DEFAULT_MAX_TOTAL_EDGES, GraphAnalysisError, MAX_GRAPH_KEY_CODE_UNITS, MIN_GATED_DESCENDANTS_FOR_REVIEW, analyzeGraphStructure, analyzeHardEdgeCounterfactuals, createTraversalCounter, partitionFrontier, previewGraphSnapshot, resolveGraphPolicy, validateGraphSnapshot. The requested additions exist with the named signatures in lease-resource.ts, lease-fencing.ts, resource-model.ts, and budget-reservation.ts. AuthorityOutcome's false arm transitively names AuthorityRejection, AuthorityIssue, AuthorityErrorCode, RejectionSecurityRecord, and LeaseState; budget reservation signatures transitively name BudgetAccountState, BudgetMeterBuckets, BudgetPolicyOutcome, and BudgetReservePurpose. All referenced authority/budget .js bridges are already tracked.
planningNotes.risks: Keep runtime values and type-only exports separate: type exports must not change Object.keys. The expected namespace must be a hand-written 36-name list (17 existing + 19 approved additions), never derived from the namespace. Use explicit named exports, not export *. The package-root probe must run through `pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec node` from the repo root so Node resolves the package self-reference; bare `node -e` at the workspace root has no @moe/scheduler link and is not a valid control. The negative control must assert literal ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. If any requested type cannot be exported without changing its defining module/signature, stop and report blocked.
